description: Owner-labeled speaker ground truth for the Agent/Caller transcript relabel pass (OPENAI_TRANSCRIPT_LABEL_MODEL). Each case stores exactly: id, call_log_id, labeled_at, labeled_by (owner), transcript_sha256 (sha256 of the raw diarized transcript rebuilt from call_log.transcript_structured exactly as normalizeOpenAITranscript renders it), and segment_speakers — one agent/caller label per non-empty diarized segment. Any other key is rejected, so transcript text, names, phone numbers, and addresses cannot enter this file. Generate a labeling sheet with: node server/scripts/speaker-label-eval.js --sheet (the sheet is written to a private 0600 file — stdout stays PII-free; read it privately, paste only the corrected stubs here, then delete the file). segment_speakers[i] labels the i-th non-empty diarized segment; transcript_sha256 pins that alignment — a re-transcribed call no longer scores (transcript_drift) instead of scoring against shifted segments.
